answer: Reef-Raven Spiral Challenge. Each agent gets a unique challenge: derive a spiral path through its own recent transaction subgraph, then locate a “reef” node whose local signature matches a posted raven hash. Answers are checked against the requester’s live graph, so no solution is reusable or transferable. Costs an attacker fresh graph history and per-attempt compute plus one real interaction per account, since replay or shared answers fail verification.
